🔮 I CAN READ YOUR MIND 🔮
🆕 UPDATE 1: THE MIND SHOP IS OPEN!

Think of ANYTHING. A YouTuber, an anime character, a Roblox game. Answer my questions and I'll tell you exactly what you're thinking of.

✨ NEW IN UPDATE 1
💎 Earn GEMS every round: +10 when I read your mind, +25 when you stump me
🛍️ Spend them in the brand-new SHOP: skins, add-ons, magic auras and themes
🎃 LIMITED Halloween bundle: the Headless Horseman + Haunted Night
🧠 SMARTER AI: our most advanced mind-reading brain yet. It learns from how real players answer

🧠 100,000+ things in my head, from viral memes to ancient philosophers
⚡ PLAY AGAIN has 0 wait: I tell you instantly
🔁 Come back tomorrow: I'll know even more than today

👀 COMING SOON: REVERSE MODE. This time YOU read MY mind.

Think you can beat me? Pick something weird. 👀
👍 LIKE the game if I read your mind!
